description: Source code for a Code 128 barcode generator class, including barcode pattern definitions, encoding, validation, and decomposition methods.

classes.name: Code128
classes.description: A class for generating Code 128 barcodes, supporting encoding, validation, and decomposition of barcode data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the barcode value, ensuring it contains only valid characters.

methods.name: _trailingDigitsToC
methods.description: Optimizes encoding by converting trailing digit sequences to Code C for double density.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the barcode value into a sequence of barcode patterns.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Decomposes the encoded barcode into a human-readable pattern string.
